# Experiment 2: record for Stage 3 (generated by scripts/s2_e2_stage3.py)

No model was run for this file except the teacher re-qualification it reports. No test split was scored.

## 1. The corrected engine

| greedy, 400 own-family tasks | success | outcomes changed against Experiment 1 | same text as full re-encoding | s per episode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| e1_s15_D1600_r0, Experiment 1 path | 87.5% | — | — | 1.62 |
| e1_s15_D1600_r0, R1-R4 | 87.5% | 4 | 22/24 | 0.66 |
| e1_s15_D1600_r0, R1-R4 and R6 (corrected) | 88.0% | 4 | 24/24 | 0.43 |
| e1_s15_D1600_r0, R6 against R1-R4 | | 4 outcomes differ, 5 episodes differ in length or calls | | |
| e1_s15_D25_r0, Experiment 1 path | 89.0% | — | — | 1.62 |
| e1_s15_D25_r0, R1-R4 | 88.8% | 1 | 24/24 | 0.65 |
| e1_s15_D25_r0, R1-R4 and R6 (corrected) | 88.8% | 1 | 24/24 | 0.44 |
| e1_s15_D25_r0, R6 against R1-R4 | | 2 outcomes differ, 3 episodes differ in length or calls | | |

Seed adapter on `dev` (600 tasks, greedy): 25.7% on R1-R4, 25.8% on R6; 3 tasks changed from failure to success and 2 the other way; 32 episodes differ in length or calls.

Sampled attempts of cycle 1 (same task, seed and attempt number on both engines): 5,664 pairs, 4,694 with identical text (82.9%), 72 with a different outcome; success 24.9% and 24.8%.

The first version of R6 changed 113 of 400 outcomes and was rejected by the calibration guard. Cause: attention scores rounded to bfloat16 before the softmax; not visible on a CPU, where the tests run in float32.

Not measured: the corrected engine against itself (the same adapter and tasks scored twice); Experiment 0 measured 0 of 720 for the Experiment 1 path.

## 2. The repeated pilot's audit: what was checked by program and what was read

| | episodes |
|---|---|
| accepted in the two cycles | 960 |
| sampled, each checked by program | 200 |
| of these, read: flagged by the program | 19 |
| of these, read: unflagged, drawn blind | 20 |
| checked by program only, not read | 161 |
| false accepts found | 0 |

The 19 flagged episodes are all 19 accepted episodes that are not strictly successful: that stratum was read in full. Of the 941 strictly successful ones, 181 were sampled, none was flagged, and 20 were read.

| one-sided 95% upper bound on the share of false accepts | strictly successful stratum | all accepted |
|---|---|---|
| if the programs check is relied on | 1.6% | 1.6% |
| from reading alone | 13.9% | 13.6% |

The program establishes, for each of the unflagged episodes: its calls are the oracle's calls, its answer states no value the reference answer lacks, it uses no identifier it had not observed and it passes the rule's own checks. Reading alone supports the 2% limit only with 149 episodes read and none found false (236 if one is found). Reader: the assistant that ran the pilot, with a written verdict per episode; no person and no second reader.

## 5. Cost of Stage 3 at the repeated pilot's measurements

Yield 37.1%, 0.29 s per attempt, 3.19 s per step; a twin episode takes 1.16 times an original one (measured on `dev`). Per final adapter: 2,800 test episodes and 1,952 twin episodes. Every figure includes job overhead and a 25% contingency.

| | 3A | 3B | twins in 3A | twins in 3B | 3A with twins | 3B with twins | both |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| test splits on the corrected engine | 91 | 44 | 13.3 | 6.0 | **104** | **50** | 154 |
| test splits on the Experiment 1 path (the plan's rule while the engine is not approved) | 121 | 60 | 49.4 | 22.1 | **171** | **83** | 253 |

A repeat of the corrected engine against itself (seed adapter, `dev`, twice): about 0.34 USD.
